messages.text: Khang, Duncan and Zhang named as Stanford's Solheim Cup captains' picks

metadata.summary: Megan Khang, Rose Zhang and Lindy Duncan have been named as Angela Stanford's three captains' picks for next month's Solheim Cup, as Team USA's full 12-player squad was officially confirmed on Monday.
metadata.content: Solheim Cup 2026: Angela Stanford names Megan Khang, Rose Zhang and Lindy Duncan as captain's picks, as Team USA squad confirmed | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to content Solheim Cup 2026: Angela Stanford names Megan Khang, Rose Zhang and Lindy Duncan as captain's picks, as Team USA squad confirmed Team USA’s captain Angela Stanford has finalised her 12-player squad for September's Solheim Cup; captain's pick Lindy Duncan is one of two debutants in the side alongside Auston Kim; watch the Solheim Cup live from September 11-13 on Sky Sports Golf Ed Carruthers Digital Sports Journalist Monday 24 August 2026 20:53, UK Image: Megan Khang has been named as one of Angela Stanford's three captains' picks for this September's Solheim Cup Megan Khang, Rose Zhang and Lindy Duncan have been named as Angela Stanford's three captains' picks for next month's Solheim Cup, as Team USA's full 12-player squad was officially confirmed on Monday. Following this weekend's CPKC Women's Open, Andrea Lee and Alison Lee also both earned qualifying spots for Team USA via the Rolex Women's World Golf Rankings. They will join Nelly Korda, Angel Yin, Jennifer Kupcho, Yealimi Noh, Auston Kim, Lauren Coughlin and Allisen Corpuz, who all qualified automatically for the tournament via the Solheim Cup points list.
